articles.title: Vanderbilt at Florida: Rain, a Home Finale, and a Freshman on the Road
articles.page_title: Vanderbilt at Florida: Rain, a Home Finale, and a Freshman on the Road | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Vanderbilt Commodores at Florida Gators · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Ben Hill Griffin Stadium · Gainesville
articles.text:
Rain has been pounding Gainesville all week, and Florida's own Saturday game-day story says more is in the forecast for part of the Vanderbilt game at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium. That is a messy way to close the home schedule, and it fits the way this season has felt. "This has been the most up-and-down [team] I've been around," coach Jon Sumrall said this week. "The inconsistency has driven me crazy."

Florida is 6-4 and already bowl-eligible after last week's 21-14 win at Kentucky, the program's first in Lexington since 2019. A win today would give Sumrall a winning record at home in his first season after back-to-back home losses to South Carolina and Oklahoma, and it would give the Gators a winning SEC record for the first time in six years, per the school's Saturday writeup. On Friday the football account posted that the program has now sold out 24 straight games, which is the kind of stubborn love this place still has even when the results bounce around.

Aaron Philo is slated to make his first home start since the South Carolina loss, looking to build on 119 passing yards and 102 rushing yards at Kentucky. Junior running back Jadan Baugh, who ran for 69 yards and a touchdown in that game, is less than 100 yards from a second straight 1,000-yard season. Waiting on the other sideline is true freshman Jared Curtis, 170 of 264 for 1,880 yards, eight touchdowns and eight interceptions. Florida defensive coordinator Brad White called him "maybe as talented a freshman QB, maybe, that I've ever seen," pointing to his arm, his running and his confidence. Curtis's leading receiver, senior Junior Sherrill, has 63 catches for 847 yards and a 47-game reception streak that Florida said is the longest active streak in the FBS.

Linebacker Aaron Chiles put the motivation in plain language earlier in the week: he wants the seniors to remember that their last home game was a win in The Swamp. Vanderbilt is 4-6 and 1-6 in the league, and the Commodores have their own pride to play for on a wet afternoon. Gainesville will find out if this version of the Gators can handle a good week better than it has some of the others.

articles.title: Wofford at Ole Miss: A 62-Week Ranking Streak Meets a Farewell Class
articles.page_title: Wofford at Ole Miss: A 62-Week Ranking Streak Meets a Farewell Class | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Wofford Terriers at Ole Miss Rebels · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Vaught-Hemingway Stadium · Oxford
articles.text:
Oxford will honor a senior class that coach Pete Golding says is 40-11 and can become the winningest group in Ole Miss history with three more victories, and it will do it under a ranking streak the school is proud of. Ole Miss is No. 25 this week, which the program's Friday "What To Watch For" notes said extends a run of 62 consecutive weeks in the AP Poll, the second-longest streak in school history behind only 1957-63.

The Rebels are 6-4 and host 5-6 Wofford at 11 a.m. Central at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium, just the second meeting in the series after a 2016 game in Oxford. Golding spent practice week talking about the people, not the mismatch. He called center Brycen Sanders "a warrior" who "loves this place" and "loves the game" and will give everything he has "regardless if he's 100 percent or not." Tight end Caleb Odom, who has 34 catches this season and ranks ninth in program history among tight ends with 53 career receptions, said the goal now is finishing with nine wins. "We built a brotherhood over this year and that's something that can't be broken," Odom said. He also said the Egg Bowl is out there, "though the focus right now is on Wofford."

That visitor is closing its own season. Wofford announced this month that head coach Shawn Watson will conclude his coaching career after 2026, and the school named Mike Houston as his successor. The Terriers' own preview called Saturday the final game of the year, coming after three straight losses. Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss is among the national top 20 in passing touchdowns (19) and passing yards (2,486), and pass rusher Suntarine Perkins has 7.0 tackles for loss and 3.5 sacks this season, adding to career marks the school lists among the program's best.

Golding has been telling his team to treat the day like an SEC game anyway. Odom's version was simpler: "We just need to go out there and have fun. Just play free and just play fast." Oxford has a farewell to give. The Rebels still have to earn it.

articles.title: BYU at Kansas: The Best 4-6 Team Poppinga Has Ever Seen
articles.page_title: BYU at Kansas: The Best 4-6 Team Poppinga Has Ever Seen | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: BYU Cougars at Kansas Jayhawks · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium · Lawrence
articles.text:
Lawrence is supposed to be breezy on Saturday, with AccuWeather on ESPN's game page showing 25 mph gusts and only a 4 percent chance of rain, which is a fitting welcome for a No. 10 BYU team trying to keep a College Football Playoff hope alive against a 4-6 Kansas team that just ran over West Virginia. BYU defensive coordinator Poppinga did not dress it up. "So, yeah, they are the best 4-6 team I've ever seen," he said, "and I am not kidding when I say that. They caught my attention immediately when I turned on the film on Sunday."

The Jayhawks are 4-6 and 2-5 in the Big 12, one of two remaining wins from bowl eligibility, and they arrive with momentum from a 37-14 victory at West Virginia. Quarterback Isaiah Marshall rushed for a career-high 164 yards in that game, his fourth 100-yard rushing game of the season, and completed 15 of 18 passes for 152 yards. Poppinga said Marshall "is as dynamic as we've seen as a runner down the field." He even compared the way Marshall runs and throws on the move to Lamar Jackson, then laughed at the shared No. 8 jersey. Linebacker Jake Clifton, likely making his fourth start with rover Isaiah Glasker ruled out, called Marshall "very comparable to Utah's quarterback" and warned that he can sit in the pocket "and then take off for 40 yards."

BYU is 8-2 and 5-2 in the league, and Deseret News noted the Cougars are 1-2 in Big 12 road games this season. The other quarterback in this one, Bear Bachmeier, has 449 rushing yards and 10 rushing touchdowns, and KSL's game-day preview pointed out that both sophomores lead their own teams in rushing. Kansas has a rushing offense the Deseret story put at 210.7 yards a game; BYU's rushing defense was listed at 100.3. Strength on strength, in the weather, at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium.

The Jayhawks need this one to keep a disappointing season from ending early. The Cougars need it so the bigger goals don't leak away on a breezy Saturday in Lawrence. Poppinga said Kansas has his team's "full attention." The Booth will find out if that was just polite talk.

articles.title: Colorado at Cincinnati: One Win From a Bowl, 22 Seniors Walking Out
articles.page_title: Colorado at Cincinnati: One Win From a Bowl, 22 Seniors Walking Out | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Colorado Buffaloes at Cincinnati Bearcats · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Nippert Stadium · Cincinnati
articles.text:
Cincinnati is 5-5, it has one home game left, and 22 seniors are going to walk onto Nippert Stadium one last time before Colorado kicks off at noon. A win would make the Bearcats bowl-eligible. That is the whole assignment, and it arrives after a 41-13 loss at Iowa State that coach Scott Satterfield called a "really bad" first quarter and a day with no complementary football.

"Certainly this week we have to play better," Satterfield said Tuesday. He called Colorado, coming off a 42-32 win against Houston, a team that "just played great football" over the last three quarters of that game, with an aggressive defense that "will bring a lot of pressure." Offensive lineman Joe Cotton, one of those seniors, did not need a sales pitch. "It is the last game at Nippert, so we have that extra motivation to leave it all out there on the field," he said. "We are going to have everything we have, and at the end of the day that is all we can do."

Quarterback JC French IV is also being honored, and Satterfield said the staff felt "very confident" that receiver JV Gibson, still in the concussion protocol after last week, would be ready after going through a walkthrough. That is the coach talking, not a game-day card. Cincinnati's own notes say the 22 honorees include four-year pieces such as Antwan Peek Jr., Jonathan Thompson, Evan Tengesdahl and Judea Milon. Satterfield, who has been through senior days at other stops, called this one "kind of surreal."

Colorado is 4-6 and just got its most impressive win of the year on the road. Cincinnati has lost five of its last six and still has a packed house and a farewell to play for. The Bearcats came back from the Iowa State trip with what Satterfield called a good attitude and a sharp walkthrough. Now they have to turn that into a Saturday the seniors can keep.

articles.title: Syracuse at Boston College: Throw the Records Out the Window
articles.page_title: Syracuse at Boston College: Throw the Records Out the Window | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Syracuse Orange at Boston College Eagles · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Alumni Stadium (Chestnut Hill, MA) · Chestnut Hill
articles.text:
Fran Brown did not bother with the records when he looked ahead to Chestnut Hill. "Going against this team, you throw records out of the window," the Syracuse coach said. "It's going to be good football, backyard football. It's going to be a lot of fun going up there to compete against them in their home." Boston College is 4-6 and closing its home schedule on Jay McGillis Memorial Senior Day, named for the former Eagles safety. Syracuse is 5-5 and one win from becoming bowl-eligible. The Eagles need both of their remaining games.

This is the 60th meeting in a series the Orange lead, and Syracuse's own notes call Boston College their fifth-most frequent opponent. The visitors arrive after a 34-31 comeback at NC State, a 21-point fourth quarter, and another one-score finish. The Orange have played a national-high eight games decided by one score this season, including seven in a row, and Brown's teams are 12-6 in those games since he arrived. "We just want to win the day, and they are consistently winning the day," he said. Freshman receiver Calvin Russell III tied the ACC and Syracuse single-game receptions record with 17 catches for 137 yards and a touchdown in that win, and Justus Ross-Simmons caught the go-ahead score and the two-point conversion in the final minute.

The problem in front of them is quarterback Mason McKenzie, who has 1,667 passing yards and a team-high 686 rushing yards. "This kid is dynamic," Brown said. "He's all over the football field. He's a highlight tape just running around and making plays. He's intelligent and you can see that he leads." Boston College's notes also point to a pass defense that has 13 interceptions, which the school said led the ACC, and to receiver Umari Hatcher, who has 1,045 yards for Syracuse.

Alumni Stadium will spend the noon hour remembering McGillis and sending off its seniors. The Orange will spend it trying to live in the moment one more time, because a bowl season is sitting right there if they can.

articles.matchup: Wake Forest Demon Deacons at Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Bobby Dodd Stadium · Atlanta
articles.text:
Georgia Tech is calling it one last Saturday on The Flats, and the school spent the week inviting students to pack Bobby Dodd Stadium for Senior Day against Wake Forest. The live card on this site lists the Demon Deacons at No. 13; ESPN has them at No. 10 in the AP and coaches polls and No. 11 in the College Football Playoff rankings, and Georgia Tech's official preview billed them as a top-10 visitor. The annual Michael Isenhour Toy Drive is part of the day, and the Yellow Jackets' Friday notes even pointed fans toward a concert at Callaway Plaza after the game. That is a lot of ceremony for a 3-7 team hosting a 9-1 league heavyweight at noon on ESPN.

That is the pride the home side is hanging onto. Wake Forest is 9-1 and 6-1 in the ACC, the kind of visitor that usually ends someone else's home schedule in a hurry, and this is the last home Saturday of the year against a 9-1 league heavyweight.

Key has been answering questions all week about how a 3-7 roster, banged up and short-handed, is supposed to throw a farewell party and a football game at the same time. The Jackets have a chance to send those 44 seniors out with a noise the rest of the ACC would have to respect. Wake Forest has a chance to take another step toward the league's championship game. Atlanta will be loud for the people walking off The Flats. It will be louder if they make the Demon Deacons work for the afternoon.

articles.title: Northwestern at Minnesota: A Home Finale, and Braun's Quarterback Is Still Out
articles.page_title: Northwestern at Minnesota: A Home Finale, and Braun's Quarterback Is Still Out | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Northwestern Wildcats at Minnesota Golden Gophers · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Huntington Bank Stadium · Minneapolis
articles.text:
Minnesota is trying to turn a 5-5 season into a sixth win on Senior Day, and the school's own preview made a point of how hard this place has been to visit. Since the start of the 2025 season the Gophers are 11-2 at Huntington Bank Stadium and 7-1 at home against Big Ten teams, a home-conference mark the notes tied with Indiana, Ohio State and USC for the best in the league over that span. A sixth win this year would be P.J. Fleck's eighth six-win season, which Minnesota said would rank third in program history behind only Henry L. Williams and Bernie Bierman.

Northwestern arrives at 6-4 and 3-4 in the league, a visitor the Gophers' notes listed as receiving votes, and the Wildcats have to do it without starting quarterback Aidan Chiles for a third straight week, per On3's report on the final availability list. Minnesota leads the all-time series 56-38-5, but the Gophers have lost the last two meetings, including a 38-35 game at Wrigley Field last Nov. 22. Saturday is the home finale, 11 a.m. Central on FS1, and it is the last time this senior class will hear that building at full volume.

On3, citing the final report with no late changes, also listed Minnesota defensive tackles Riley Sunram and Theorin Randle out for a second straight game, with several other Gophers still sidelined. The Wildcats have a list of their own. That is a lot of absence for a game this close on paper, and it puts the day on whoever is healthy enough to walk out for the farewell. Minnesota has been sturdy at home. Northwestern has the better record. Somebody is going to leave the stadium with a win they can feel in December.

articles.title: Ohio State at Nebraska: Rhule Puts Jeremiah Smith Next to Julio Jones
articles.page_title: Ohio State at Nebraska: Rhule Puts Jeremiah Smith Next to Julio Jones | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Ohio State Buckeyes at Nebraska Cornhuskers · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Memorial Stadium (Lincoln, NE) · Lincoln
articles.text:
Lincoln is wrapping three farewells into one noon kickoff: Military Appreciation Day, a College Football Hall of Fame honor for Ndamukong Suh, and Senior Day for a group Matt Rhule said includes six players who spent their entire careers at Nebraska. "The best thing we can do is honor, whether it's the military salute, to honor our fans and our crowd and our families, to honor our seniors, to honor them is to play really good football versus a great team," Rhule said Monday.

The great team is Ohio State, 7-3 and 5-2 in the Big Ten. The live card on this site lists the Buckeyes at No. 20; ESPN has them at No. 14 in the College Football Playoff rankings, No. 16 in the AP poll, and No. 17 in the coaches poll. Rhule did not waste any scouting-speak on Jeremiah Smith. "Jeremiah Smith is undoubtedly the best player in college football," he said. "When I was in the NFL I had a chance to watch, compete against Julio Jones and this is what Jeremiah reminds me of, that level of player." He also pointed to Bo Jackson's running game and to a Matt Patricia defense he called "really, really multiple." Nebraska is 6-4 and 3-4, coming off a 31-0 win at Rutgers, and Rhule said the Huskers are second in the Big Ten in rushing offense at 187 yards a game and 6-0 when they run for 150. He also said Anthony Colandrea leads the league in conference-game offense and that Nebraska has not turned the ball over in the last two games.

Ohio State is coming to a sold-out Memorial Stadium with quarterback Julian Sayin still out, as he has been since an elbow injury against Indiana. Luke Fahey has been the Buckeyes' passer in that stretch. Ryan Day said Thursday he was "anxious" to get Brock Boyd back after four missed games and that he thought Boyd would be "available," even if "how much he'll play, I'm not really sure." Left guard Luke Montgomery, out last week with an illness, was off the report and expected back.

The catch for Nebraska is on the other side of the ball. The Friday Big Ten availability report, as relayed by Eleven Warriors, ruled out linebacker Owen Chambliss, defensive tackle Jahsear Whittington and cornerback Andrew Marshall, with defensive end Anthony Jones Jr. doubtful. Chambliss is tied for the team lead with 55 tackles. Whittington leads the Huskers with 5.5 sacks. A farewell day in Lincoln usually asks the home crowd to raise the noise. This one also asks a thinned-out defense to measure itself against the player Rhule just compared to Julio Jones.

articles.title: Wisconsin at Purdue: A New Quarterback Walks Into Ross-Ade
articles.page_title: Wisconsin at Purdue: A New Quarterback Walks Into Ross-Ade | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Wisconsin Badgers at Purdue Boilermakers · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Ross-Ade Stadium · West Lafayette
articles.text:
Wisconsin is expected to hand the ball to Colton Joseph at quarterback on Saturday at Ross-Ade Stadium, a change that has followed Ryan Hopkins through a week of sore reports. On3's Badger sites said Joseph is the expected starter and that Hopkins, listed as probable, was dealing with a non-throwing shoulder and a back that coach Luke Fickell described as "really tight." Fickell said he hoped it would loosen up. That is a thin way to walk into a 6-4 versus 3-7 game on the road, and it is the clearest piece of news out of Madison this week.

The Badgers are 6-4 and still playing for a bowl position. Purdue is 3-7 and closing a hard year at home, on NBC, at noon. On3 also reported that Wisconsin has Jai'mier Scott and Sebastian Cheeks back, with Javan Robinson and Matt Jung out. Purdue's third availability report, per On3, downgraded an offensive starter and listed tight end George Burhenn as doubtful, with Kylan Fox, cornerback Raderrion Daniels and defensive tackle Rodney Lora out. Those are dated reports from the week, not a final Saturday card, but they sketch the picture: two battered rosters, one new quarterback, and a West Lafayette crowd that has not had many noon games worth circling.

Joseph's job is simple to say and hard to do. Keep the Badgers on schedule, don't hand Purdue a short field, and give Wisconsin's seniors a road win they can take home. Purdue's job is to make the new quarterback play in a hurry. Ross-Ade has the stage. Somebody has to take it.

articles.title: East Carolina at Army: Bowl Number Three Travels to West Point
articles.page_title: East Carolina at Army: Bowl Number Three Travels to West Point | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: East Carolina Pirates at Army Black Knights · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Michie Stadium · West Point
articles.text:
East Carolina already has its bowl, and the Pirates' Friday game preview made sure nobody missed it. A 17-16 win at Charlotte last week made them bowl-eligible for a third straight season, the first time that has happened since 2012-14, and it sent them to West Point with a 6-4 record and a 4-2 mark in the American. Ashton Gray ran for two touchdowns in that game, and the defense held Charlotte to 200 yards of offense, including a scoreless second half in which the 49ers managed two first downs.

Army is 5-4 and 4-2 in the league, coming off a bye after a 24-21 loss to Air Force. Saturday is the 11th meeting in the series, which East Carolina leads 9-1, though the two have split the two conference games since Army joined the American in 2024. Kickoff is noon at Michie Stadium, on CBS Sports Network, in a place that always feels like it has more at stake than a November record. The Black Knights had the week to get their legs back. The Pirates had the week to prove the Charlotte win was a beginning, not a sigh of relief.

Blake Harrell, in his second full run as East Carolina's head coach, has the Pirates in a three-year bowl stretch and a 20-9 mark in 29 games as the school's official preview laid out. Army, under Jeff Monken, has to answer for a close loss to the Air Force and then for a visitor that just learned how to close a game on the road. West Point at noon does not need extra decoration. Two bowl-minded teams, a short list of first downs for the last opponent, and a stadium that will be loud for the home side if the Pirates let it get that way.

articles.title: North Texas at Tulane: A New Quarterback, and a Title Race They Will Not Discuss
articles.page_title: North Texas at Tulane: A New Quarterback, and a Title Race They Will Not Discuss | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: North Texas Mean Green at Tulane Green Wave · 12:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Yulman Stadium · New Orleans
articles.text:
Chris Jimerson Jr.'s last start came in December 2024 in front of more than 36,000 people at AT&T Stadium, when he was still at North Crowley High School. On Saturday the North Texas sophomore is the man under center at Yulman Stadium, with the Mean Green still tied atop the American and a New Orleans road game standing in the way. Coach Neal Brown made the stakes sound smaller on purpose. "We have to find a way to win this week," he said. "We're not worried about the conference race. We just have to figure out a way to win this game."

North Texas is 7-3 and, after a loss at UTSA, in a three-way tie with UTSA and Memphis. The school said the Mean Green would need to win out and get help. Defensive lineman David Onuoha sounded like his coach: "If we don't beat Tulane this week then it doesn't matter, so the focus is only on beating Tulane." Brown called the second half at UTSA, when the defense allowed 30 yards of offense for a long stretch, the group's best work, and he said the offense "should be embarrassed" and "really hungry to get back out there."

Tulane is 5-5 and, per Crescent City Sports, still carrying its own conference-title hopes into the game, with questions of its own in the backfield. Coach Will Hall said Jimerson's mobility creates "a whole other set of challenges." The thing that changed the most this week is who is taking the snaps. New Orleans at 11 a.m. Central, ESPNU, and a quarterback who has not started a college game. Brown still believes his team is "as good or better as any team in our league." Saturday is the prove-it part.

articles.title: North Carolina at Virginia: Two 5-5 Teams, One Bowl Spot in Charlottesville
articles.page_title: North Carolina at Virginia: Two 5-5 Teams, One Bowl Spot in Charlottesville | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: North Carolina Tar Heels at Virginia Cavaliers · 12:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Scott Stadium · Charlottesville
articles.text:
Both teams are 5-5, the winner becomes bowl-eligible, and Scott Stadium gets the 12:30 kickoff that decides it. North Carolina and Virginia have been playing each other longer than most of the country has been playing anybody, and Virginia's own notes have called this the South's Oldest Rivalry, tied for the second-most played series between FBS opponents. The history will take care of itself. The sixth win will not.

The week has been about who can actually walk out there. On3 and the Fayetteville Observer, tracking the ACC reports, have had North Carolina quarterback Billy Edwards Jr. listed as questionable, with freshman Travis Burgess the likely starter if Edwards cannot go. Pass rusher Melkart Abou-Jaoude was listed out with a broken hand, and safety Greg Smith was listed out for the first half. Virginia's list has been even longer, with reports of 13 Cavaliers out, including linebackers Maddox Marcellus and Landon Danley and safety Corey Costner. Those are midweek and Thursday updates, not a final Saturday card, but they tell you how fragile this one is for two teams that cannot afford a wasted possession.

A 5-5 home finale against a 5-5 rival is the kind of afternoon Charlottesville was built for, even when the rosters are patched. Somebody is going to leave Scott Stadium with a bowl. Somebody is going to leave with a winter that starts too soon. The oldest rivalry on the block is just the setting. The sixth win is the whole story.

articles.title: Tennessee Tech at Mississippi State: Fan Fest at 8, Senior Day at 11:38, and a Slide to End
articles.page_title: Tennessee Tech at Mississippi State: Fan Fest at 8, Senior Day at 11:38, and a Slide to End | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles at Mississippi State Bulldogs · 1:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Davis Wade Stadium · Starkville
articles.text:
Starkville starts early, and the athletic department published the whole morning so nobody could miss it. Coca-Cola Fan Fest and the ticket office open at 8 a.m., the Dawg Walk begins at 9:55, the gates open at 10, and the Senior Day ceremony is set for 11:38 a.m. before a noon Central kickoff against Tennessee Tech. That is a lot of ritual for a 4-6 Mississippi State team that has been looking for its first win since Week 4, and it is a loud welcome for a 9-2 FCS visitor that just finished a conference championship run of its own.

The Bulldogs' Friday notes hung the pride on the people who have kept showing up. Anthony Evans III is tied for the SEC lead with 65 catches and has 800 yards. Sanfrisco Magee has three catches and three touchdowns over the last two games, tying for the league lead in receiving scores. Kyle Ferrie has made 100 consecutive extra points and is seven points shy of 300 for his career. Will Whitson has scored in back-to-back weeks, a fumble return against Vanderbilt and a safety against Auburn. Center Canon Boone, Evans and cornerback Kelley Jones are each one start from 24 in a row dating to last season.

Tennessee Tech coach Bobby Wilder, in midweek comments relayed nationally, did not pretend the size gap is small, and he also did not come to Davis Wade Stadium to collect a souvenir. Mississippi State coach Jeff Lebby has been evaluating quarterbacks Parker Puckett and Brodie McWhorter on who can move the chains, score and take care of the football. Senior Day in Starkville is supposed to feel like a thank-you. The Golden Eagles are 9-2 and do not have to donate one. If the Bulldogs want the send-off to land, they have to end the slide first.

articles.title: Houston at West Virginia: Houston Finally Gets to Morgantown
articles.page_title: Houston at West Virginia: Houston Finally Gets to Morgantown | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Houston Cougars at West Virginia Mountaineers · 1:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Milan Puskar Stadium · Morgantown
articles.text:
Houston had never played in Morgantown until today. The Cougars' own preview made that the first thing to know: two previous Big 12 meetings with West Virginia were at TDECU Stadium, including a 2023 Hail Mary that was Houston's first conference win, and Saturday is the program's first trip to Milan Puskar Stadium. The Cougars are 7-3 and 4-3, No. 14 in the live rankings we publish, and they arrive after a 42-32 loss at Colorado that knocked them out of the loudest playoff talk. West Virginia is 5-5 and 2-5, still hunting the sixth win that would make the Mountaineers bowl-eligible, with a trip to Utah waiting after this.

Houston's preview hung a lot of the pride on quarterback Conner Weigman, who has 68 touchdowns since 2025, 47 through the air and 18 on the ground, and a 17-6 record in a Cougar uniform. The defense has forced a turnover in nine straight games, the longest streak of the Willie Fritz era, after Javion White's interception at Colorado. The offensive front is a Joe Moore Award semifinalist for the first time in school history. West Virginia, in the same notes, was listed 13th nationally in offense at 458.9 yards a game and sixth in rushing at 240.7, which is exactly the kind of visitor a Senior Day crowd in Morgantown wants to believe in.

The Mountaineers' Saturday game-day story called it Senior Day and a chance to rebound from a 37-14 loss to Kansas. Houston called it a road finale. Somebody's season tilts on the first trip this series has ever made to this building. The home crowd will be in gold and blue, and the Cougars have to find out if a first visit to this stadium feels new, or like the start of a long afternoon.

articles.title: Western Kentucky at Liberty: The People Who Run the Stadium Get Their Day
articles.page_title: Western Kentucky at Liberty: The People Who Run the Stadium Get Their Day | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Western Kentucky Hilltoppers at Liberty Flames · 1:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Williams Stadium (VA) · Lynchburg
articles.text:
Liberty is 9-1 and 6-0 in Conference USA, it has already locked up the league's regular-season high ground, and Saturday is still being treated like a thank-you note. The school's game-day story billed the afternoon as Senior Day at Williams Stadium, with Employee Appreciation built in so the people who keep the place running get their turn in the building. Western Kentucky's official preview said the Flames would honor 20 seniors before kickoff. The Hilltoppers are 4-6 and 3-3, coming to Lynchburg at 1 p.m. on ESPN+ to see whether a 9-1 home team will let them hang around.

WKU's notes also said Liberty leads the series 5-0. That is a blunt piece of history, and it fits a blunt present: the Flames have been the class of this league, and the Hilltoppers have to steal a road win to keep a disappointing year from leaking away. Liberty's broadcast window is ESPN+, with the home radio crew on 88.3 FM, and the school has been selling the day as a celebration first. That only works if the football matches the ceremony.

A 9-1 team at home, on Senior Day, against a 4-6 visitor is supposed to feel settled by halftime. Western Kentucky did not ride six hours for a ceremony. The employees get honored. The seniors get introduced. Then somebody has to go play a Conference USA game that still counts for the people who came to work and the people who came to say goodbye.

articles.page_title: Western Kentucky at Liberty: The People Who Run the Stadium Get Their Day | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Western Kentucky Hilltoppers at Liberty Flames · 1:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Williams Stadium (VA) · Lynchburg
articles.text:
Market check, Western Kentucky at Liberty: DraftKings LIB -17.5, total 53.5.

Liberty is 9-1 and 6-0 in Conference USA, it has already locked up the league's regular-season high ground, and Saturday is still being treated like a thank-you note. The school's game-day story billed the afternoon as Senior Day at Williams Stadium, with Employee Appreciation built in so the people who keep the place running get their turn in the building. Western Kentucky's official preview said the Flames would honor 20 seniors before kickoff. The Hilltoppers are 4-6 and 3-3, coming to Lynchburg at 1 p.m. on ESPN+ to see whether a 9-1 home team will let them hang around.

Prices move, so check yours before kickoff. Full preview at thecoverwindow.com.

Unofficial aggregators listed several Liberty names, but this story is not promoting those as official designations. Refresh official lists before kickoff.

WKU's notes also said Liberty leads the series 5-0. That is a blunt piece of history, and it fits a blunt present: the Flames have been the class of this league, and the Hilltoppers have to steal a road win to keep a disappointing year from leaking away. Liberty's broadcast window is ESPN+, with the home radio crew on 88.3 FM, and the school has been selling the day as a celebration first. That only works if the football matches the ceremony.

A 9-1 team at home, on Senior Day, against a 4-6 visitor is supposed to feel settled by halftime. Western Kentucky did not ride six hours for a ceremony. The employees get honored. The seniors get introduced. Then somebody has to go play a Conference USA game that still counts for the people who came to work and the people who came to say goodbye.

articles.title: Chattanooga at Alabama: Fourteen Mocs Going Home, and a Sprained Ankle in Tuscaloosa
articles.page_title: Chattanooga at Alabama: Fourteen Mocs Going Home, and a Sprained Ankle in Tuscaloosa | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Chattanooga Mocs at Alabama Crimson Tide · 2:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Bryant-Denny Stadium · Tuscaloosa
articles.text:
Fourteen Chattanooga players are going home this week, in the most literal way. The Mocs' official preview said this is the fifth straight year their regular-season finale has been in Tuscaloosa, and that 14 players on the roster are Alabama natives, including defensive end Jestin Gilmore, who is from Tuscaloosa itself. Kickoff is 2 p.m. Eastern at Bryant-Denny Stadium, Senior Day for No. 3 Alabama, an 8-2 team that has won three straight and is hosting 7-4 Chattanooga on SEC Network-plus.

The news out of Tuscaloosa has been about a sprained left ankle and how much of Keelon Russell the Tide will use. al.com reported that offensive coordinator Ryan Grubb called Russell "status quo, good to go," while coach Kalen DeBoer said the plan was to manage it and that the staff might rest him early. The same reporting listed defensive lineman Desmond Umeozulu out with turf toe and Chuck McDonald III limited with a lower-leg injury, with guard William Sanders still working back from surgery. Those are midweek comments, not a final Saturday card, but they are the questions a home finale has to answer before the band even plays.

Chattanooga is not here for a photograph. The Mocs are 7-4 and closing the regular season against a program that sits at No. 3 in the rankings we publish. Alabama is supposed to win this in a rout, and the home crowd will spend the afternoon saying goodbye to its seniors. The visitors brought 14 players who grew up in this state and a coach's week of work aimed at one clean hour. Tuscaloosa has seen this series end the year before. It has not seen this particular group try to ruin the party.

articles.title: Charlotte at Tulsa: Lamb's Warning About Getting Comfortable
articles.page_title: Charlotte at Tulsa: Lamb's Warning About Getting Comfortable | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Charlotte 49ers at Tulsa Golden Hurricane · 2:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · H. A. Chapman Stadium · Tulsa
articles.text:
Tulsa is 6-4, it has won two straight, and Saturday is the regular-season home finale at H.A. Chapman Stadium, Senior Day and Band Day at the same time, against a 1-9 Charlotte team. The official preview laid out a 1 p.m. Central kickoff on ESPN+ and a chance for the Golden Hurricane to take a third win in a row into the last week of the year. That is a dangerous kind of comfort, and it is the thing coach Tre Lamb has to worry about more than the record on the other sideline.

Charlotte is 1-9 and 1-5 in the American under second-year coach Tim Albin. Tulsa, in Lamb's second year, is 3-3 in the league and still playing for a finish that would make this home send-off feel earned. The school's week-of material sold the ceremony, the local bands, and the last look at this senior class in this stadium. The football question is simpler: can a team that just scored 60 at Tulane and 38 against Florida Atlantic stay sharp against a roster that has spent the year hunting a second win?

A 1-9 visitor can still ruin a Senior Day if the home team is already thinking about next week. Tulsa has the better team, the better recent form, and the packed-house setting. Charlotte has nothing to save and a long bus ride in which to get angry. Band Day will take care of the sound. The Golden Hurricane have to take care of the hour after the introductions.

articles.title: Missouri State at Jacksonville State: One Win From a Title Game on Senior Day
articles.page_title: Missouri State at Jacksonville State: One Win From a Title Game on Senior Day | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Missouri State Bears at Jacksonville State Gamecocks · 2:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · AmFirst Stadium · Jacksonville
articles.text:
Jacksonville State can punch its ticket to the Conference USA championship game on Saturday, and the school's Senior Day story did not hide it. A win in either of the Gamecocks' final two games would put them in the league title game, and AmFirst Stadium gets Missouri State at 1 p.m. in the home closer. Hosting that title game for a third straight year would take more help in the standings, the notes said, but the first job is simpler: win this one, honor the seniors, and keep the Southerners Reunion crowd in the building for another week.

Jax State is 7-3 and 5-1 in the league. Missouri State is 4-6 and 3-3, with wins in two of its last three conference games, and the Bears came south hoping to knock a title-game team off its own field. The matchup that has followed this game all week is quarterback Caden Creel's dual-threat work, 2,151 passing yards and 817 rushing yards, against a Missouri State team that has Isaiah Myers at 1,030 receiving yards. Those figures are from the season stats in the game files we use.

Senior Day in Jacksonville, Ala., is supposed to feel like a thank-you. This one also feels like a gate. The Gamecocks can walk through it with a win. The Bears can slam it shut and take a 4-6 season into November with a trophy-race scalp. The band alumni came home. The football still has to decide whether they get to come back next week.

articles.title: Middle Tennessee at Sam Houston: A Bowl Bid on the Road, a Skid at Home
articles.page_title: Middle Tennessee at Sam Houston: A Bowl Bid on the Road, a Skid at Home | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders at Sam Houston Bearkats · 2:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Elliott T. Bowers Stadium · Huntsville
articles.text:
Middle Tennessee is 5-5 and one win from becoming bowl-eligible, and the Blue Raiders' official preview made Saturday's 1 p.m. Central kickoff at Bowers Stadium sound exactly that simple. The trip is to Huntsville, Texas, against a 1-9 Sam Houston team that has lost seven in a row and is spending the afternoon on Senior Day. The series is tied, this is only the fifth meeting, and it is the third as conference foes. That is a short history, and it is a heavy afternoon for both locker rooms.

The Houstonian, the campus paper, described a Bearkats team trying to snap that skid in front of its seniors, with co-interim talk on the home side about putting pressure on the quarterback. Middle Tennessee coach Derek Mason, in the same week-of coverage, called Sam Houston a roster with "weapons on both sides of the ball," which is a polite way of saying a 1-9 football team can still wreck a bowl trip if you let it. The Blue Raiders have been close enough to six wins to taste it. They have not put it away.

A 5-5 team on the road, a 1-9 team at home, and a Senior Day crowd that has not had much to hold onto: that is the entire setting. Middle Tennessee wants a sixth win and a December that still has football in it. Sam Houston wants to send its seniors out with the first good hour in two months. Somebody's winter changes at Bowers Stadium.

articles.title: Iowa at Illinois: A Third Quarterback, Maybe, Against No. 15
articles.page_title: Iowa at Illinois: A Third Quarterback, Maybe, Against No. 15 | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Iowa Hawkeyes at Illinois Fighting Illini · 2:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Gies Memorial Stadium · Champaign
articles.text:
Champaign may be handing the ball to a third starting quarterback on Saturday, and that is the whole nervous energy around Gies Memorial Stadium. No. 15 Iowa, 8-2 and stingy, comes to town at 2:30 p.m. on the Big Ten Network, and Illinois coach Bret Bielema spent the week preparing Carson Boyd to play if Katin Houser cannot go. ESPN and local reports said Houser had surgery for a broken nose and is in the concussion protocol, listed as questionable, while backup Michael Clayton II is out with a hand injury. Bielema praised Boyd's accuracy and his ability to throw on the move. That is a hard way to host a top-15 defense.

Iowa is 8-2 and allows 11.7 points a game with three shutouts, a fact the Hawkeyes' own season file and every preview this week has repeated. Illinois is 6-4 and still playing for a finish that would make a Senior Day at home feel like a beginning instead of a shrug. The history between Bielema and Iowa is well known in both places, and it does not need another retelling today. The new part is the quarterback. If Houser is cleared, Illinois has its usual problem: how to score enough. If he is not, Boyd is the first answer the Illini have left.

A 2:30 kickoff in Champaign, a ranked visitor, and a home crowd that will spend the first half watching to see who takes the first snap: that is the scene. Iowa came to take care of business. Illinois came to find out if it still has a quarterback who can make the Hawkeyes play from behind.

articles.title: South Florida at Florida Atlantic: A Red Out in Boca, Two Teams at 6-4
articles.page_title: South Florida at Florida Atlantic: A Red Out in Boca, Two Teams at 6-4 | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: South Florida Bulls at Florida Atlantic Owls · 2:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Flagler Credit Union Stadium · Boca Raton
articles.text:
Florida Atlantic asked the crowd to wear red, and the school's "Know Before You Go" framed Saturday as a Coca-Cola Senior Day at Flagler Credit Union Stadium, 2:30 p.m. on ESPN+, honoring senior players and the support staff who keep the place running. Both teams are 6-4. That is a rivalry game dressed as a farewell, and it is the last time this senior class will hear its own building at full volume.

USF coach Brian Hartline, in week-of comments, said the Bulls have to get after FAU quarterback Caden Veltkamp. The Bulls have been starting Luke Kromenhoek in recent weeks after Michael Van Buren Jr.'s injury, with Van Buren's return still uncertain in the previews we used. FAU receiver Easton Messer was listed as questionable after leaving the Tulsa game, per midweek reports. Those are dated items, not a final Saturday card, but they sketch a 6-4 versus 6-4 game that can tilt on one quarterback and one receiver.

South Florida has the better recent defensive reputation in this league. Florida Atlantic has the home finale, the red shirts, and a Senior Day list that includes the people who work the building, not just the ones who play in it. Somebody is going to leave Boca with a seventh win and a cleaner path to December. Somebody is going to leave with a 6-5 record and a long ride home. The Owls asked the crowd to show up in red. The Bulls asked themselves to get a stop when it counts.

articles.title: UL Monroe at App State: A Concussion Changes the Backfield on Senior Day
articles.page_title: UL Monroe at App State: A Concussion Changes the Backfield on Senior Day | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: UL Monroe Warhawks at App State Mountaineers · 2:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Kidd Brewer Stadium · Boone
articles.text:
Boone gets a Senior Day at The Rock, and App State's official game-day preview said more than 20 players will be recognized before kickoff against UL Monroe. The Mountaineers are already bowl-eligible, 6-4 and 3-3 in the Sun Belt, coming off a 20-16 rally at Marshall after trailing 13-3. The catch is in the backfield. The same official preview ruled out running back Jaquari Lewis after he ran for 137 yards in essentially three quarters at Marshall, which means more work for Treyaun Webb and Ja'Quez Cross.

ULM is 2-8 and 2-4, but the Mountaineers' notes were careful not to treat this like a cleanup game. The Warhawks have won two of their last four after an 0-6 start, including road wins at Troy and Arkansas State. App State is 3-2 at home, with losses to Georgia State and Old Dominion around an overtime win over then-unbeaten James Madison. The official preview also pointed to ULM's run defense, 217.4 rushing yards allowed a game, and to a two-quarterback operation of Austin Carlisle and Aidan Armenta. Linebacker Alex Mitchell is out for the season; Carson Sloan had a career-high 13 tackles at Marshall.

A home finale in Boone is supposed to be a send-off. This one is also a test of whether a bowl-eligible team, missing its hottest runner, will get conservative against a 2-8 visitor that has already wrecked two road Saturday nights this month. The seniors will be introduced. Then App State has to go play like it still needs the afternoon.

articles.title: Coastal Carolina at Louisiana: A 12-Man Senior Class, and a Third Road Win to Chase
articles.page_title: Coastal Carolina at Louisiana: A 12-Man Senior Class, and a Third Road Win to Chase | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers at Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns · 3:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Our Lady of Lourdes Stadium · Lafayette
articles.text:
Lafayette will spend the hour before kickoff on a senior walk, not a movie premiere. Louisiana's official preview said a 12-man senior class will be recognized beginning at 1:45 p.m., 15 minutes before a 2 p.m. kickoff at Our Lady of Lourdes Stadium, with the Coastal Carolina game on ESPN+.

The list the school published is a full one: Tito Chikere, Kailep Edwards, Maurion Eleam, George Jackson, Collin Jacob, Jaydon Johnson, Logan Klotz, Princeton Malbrue, Kaden Moreau, Jake St. Andre, Tony Sterner and Fitzgerald West Jr. The ceremony is the send-off. The football problem is a 4-6 Coastal team that just won its home finale and, per the Chanticleers' own preview, is chasing a third straight Sun Belt road win.

Coastal is 4-6 and 3-3 in the league after a 28-21 victory over Arkansas State, a clean afternoon from Deuce Bailey (21-of-24, 208 yards, one score). The road wins already in the book are real: 27-21 at Marshall on Oct. 10 and 31-20 at Georgia State on Oct. 31. Louisiana is 7-3 and 4-2 in the West after a 42-21 win at UL Monroe on Nov. 12, when Steven Blanco and JJ Garner each ran for more than 100 yards and the Cajuns scored 28 unanswered points.

Recent meetings have not settled much. In the 2016-2025 games we can source, the series sits 2-2, including Louisiana's 34-24 win in 2024 and Coastal's 30-27 win in 2020. The Cajuns have the better record and the home finale. Coastal has the sneakier road form, and Bailey just completed 21 of 24.

A home crowd that gets its seniors on the field at 1:45, then a 4-6 visitor that has already stolen two league games away from home: that is the afternoon in Lafayette. If the Cajuns play like the group that ran away from Monroe, the send-off will feel like a send-off. If Coastal's passing stays this sharp, the seniors will have to wait a little longer to exhale.

articles.page_title: Delaware at New Mexico State: One Win From a Bowl, in a Stadium They've Never Seen | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Delaware Blue Hens at New Mexico State Aggies · 3:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Aggie Memorial Stadium · Las Cruces
articles.text:
Delaware did not come to Las Cruces for a reunion. The Blue Hens' official preview called this the first meeting between the two programs, a 3 p.m. ET ESPN+ date at Aggie Memorial Stadium, and a chance to get the sixth win that would make Delaware bowl-eligible for a second straight season.

That is not marketing copy. Last year Delaware, a first-year FBS program, reached a bowl, and the school notes it is one of two programs (with Jacksonville State) in FBS since 2012 to win a bowl in its first season at the level. The Hens are 5-5 and 3-3 in Conference USA after a 24-16 home win over FIU. Nick Minicucci went 27-of-30 for 230 yards and two scores, ran for 69 and another, and the school said that 90 percent clip set a Delaware single-game completion record (minimum 25 attempts). He has 2,115 passing yards and 18 touchdown passes, and Delaware says he leads the league in passing yards per game.

New Mexico State is 3-7 and 2-4, coming off a 27-21 overtime loss at Missouri State. Tony Sanchez is in his third year (10-24 at NMSU, per Delaware's preview). Trey Hedden has 1,272 passing yards, nine touchdowns and 10 interceptions. The backfield is the problem for visitors: James Jones, the former Delaware State and UL Monroe runner, has 1,090 rushing yards and, Delaware said, leads Conference USA in rushing yards per game (109.0). AccuWeather's forecast attached to the ESPN game page had a 31-mph gust in Las Cruces, which is a lot of wind for a passing team trying to cash a bowl bid.

A first meeting, a 5-5 team one win from a second bowl, and a 3-7 home club with the league's leading rusher: that is the scene in the desert. Minicucci just completed 27 of 30. Jones just ran for 150 in overtime at Missouri State. Somebody is going to have to answer the other.

articles.title: Florida International at Kennesaw State: Two 4-6 Teams, One Last Home Saturday in Kennesaw
articles.page_title: Florida International at Kennesaw State: Two 4-6 Teams, One Last Home Saturday in Kennesaw | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Florida International Panthers at Kennesaw State Owls · 3:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium · Kennesaw
articles.text:
Kennesaw and FIU arrive at Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium in the same boat: 4-6, with a 3 p.m. ET ESPN+ kickoff, and a league date that has to be decided on the field, not on the record. The Owls are 3-3 in league play. The Panthers are 2-4. That is the whole argument for why a late-November home Saturday in Kennesaw still matters.

FIU is coming off a 16-24 loss at Delaware, where JJ Kohl threw for 313 yards and a score but also had two interceptions, and Maguire Anderson caught nine balls for 122 yards. Kohl has 2,348 passing yards, 12 touchdowns and 12 interceptions on the year. Devonte Lyons has 706 rushing yards. Kennesaw, by contrast, just won 26-7 at Sam Houston. Rickie Collins has 1,687 passing yards, seven scores and seven interceptions; Boogie Woods III leads the Owls' ground game in the facts we can source.

The AccuWeather forecast on ESPN's game page had a 49 percent chance of rain and an 18-mph gust, which is enough to make a messy afternoon possible in Cobb County. Official sites for both programs were thin this week on a fresh game preview, so this story stays with what is dated and sourced: the records, the last boxes, and the stadium. No player is being declared out or available without a report.

Two 4-6 teams, one of them at home for a conference date, and a passing attack that just threw for 313 on the road: that is the 3 o'clock game in Kennesaw. If the Owls defend the way they did in a 26-7 win last week, the home stands will have a night. If Kohl keeps finding Anderson, the walk to the cars will be a long one.

articles.title: Samford at Auburn: Jordan-Hare Closes the Year, and Samford Walks In
articles.page_title: Samford at Auburn: Jordan-Hare Closes the Year, and Samford Walks In | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Samford Bulldogs at Auburn Tigers · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Jordan-Hare Stadium · Auburn
articles.text:
Auburn's Saturday gameday advisory framed this as the final home game of 2026 at Jordan-Hare Stadium, a 2:30 p.m. CT kickoff against Samford on SEC Network, with Tiger Walk set 2.5 hours before kickoff and a pregame Senior Day ceremony. How many seniors walk? The school's own pages do not agree. The Opening Drive on Nov. 18 said 29. The Saturday advisory said 28. Both agree the ceremony is happening, and that disagreement is worth a footnote, not a guess.

Coach Alex Golesh, in that Opening Drive, called the group invested. "That group is such a mix of guys who have been here, guys who came in," he said. "I tell those guys every Friday night I'm grateful for them." He also told his team not to take a breath: if Auburn is going to build a program that plays meaningful November games, "we have to work that way, practice that way, prepare that way." The Tigers are 6-4 and 4-4 in the SEC after a 41-9 win at Mississippi State. The Opening Drive said Auburn is 30-0-1 all-time against Samford and 16-0 at home in the series.

Samford is 4-7 after a 12-17 loss to Western Carolina, a game the Bulldogs listed as their home finale. The official Samford preview said the season wraps up Saturday on the Plains. Gabarri Johnson has 1,752 passing yards; Ken Cherry has 387 on the ground. Auburn's Byrum Brown has 1,972 passing yards and is also the Tigers' leading rusher in the facts we can source. Offensive lineman Kenneth McManus IV, talking about Samford's 3-3-5 look, said, "They present a lot of unique pictures. We'll definitely have to be prepared for that."

A home finale, a Senior Day whose head count even the school has written two ways, and an FCS visitor that just dropped its own closer: that is the afternoon on the Plains. Golesh asked his team to finish the week the right way for the fans and the seniors. The record against Samford says Auburn usually does. The 3-3-5 is the new picture in front of them.

articles.page_title: LSU at Tennessee: A Sold-Out Senior Day, and a Last-Second Loss to Shake | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: LSU Tigers at Tennessee Volunteers · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Neyland Stadium · Knoxville
articles.text:
Neyland Stadium is sold out, and Tennessee's own game preview set a Senior Day pregame ceremony for 3:18 p.m., with No. 21 LSU in town on ABC at 3:30. One ranking note, because the school and the card do not match: The live card on this site lists Tennessee at No. 8. Tennessee's Saturday preview billed the Vols at No. 9 (and, in a heading, 9/9/9). LSU's official preview also called Saturday a trip to face No. 9 Tennessee. This story stays with the card's No. 8 and No. 21 and flags the school's number.

Lane Kiffin, in LSU's preview, did not talk about old scores first. He talked about the building. "They have done a great job of creating a home field advantage," Kiffin said. "The crowd shows up early, they market it well with different ideas in the stadium. They've done a really good job with noise in there." LSU has not been to Knoxville since 2017. The Tigers' official notes say they have won three straight in that stadium, with their last loss there in 2001, and that they have won five of the last six meetings even after Tennessee's 40-13 win in Baton Rouge in 2022. All-time, LSU lists the series 10-21-3.

The Tigers are 6-4 after a last-second 21-22 loss to Texas. The Vols are 8-2 after a 22-7 win at Texas A&M. George MacIntyre has 962 passing yards in the facts we can source; DeSean Bishop leads Tennessee on the ground. Sam Leavitt has 2,797 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and 12 interceptions for LSU. In a Nov. 17 Tennessee availability, defensive staff praised work in the safety room "despite being out due to injury" for Edrees Farooq and Dylan Lewis. That is the only dated injury note this story will carry from the official pages.

A sold-out Senior Day, a visitor that has owned recent trips to Knoxville, and a home team coming off a road win at Texas A&M: that is the ABC window. Kiffin already warned his team about the noise. The pregame ceremony is on the clock at 3:18. After that, Neyland gets to do what Neyland does.

articles.page_title: Arkansas at Texas: Austin After a One-Point Escape in Baton Rouge | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Arkansas Razorbacks at Texas Longhorns · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · DKR-Texas Memorial Stadium · Austin
articles.text:
Texas just survived LSU by a point, 22-21, on the road, and now Arkansas comes to DKR-Texas Memorial Stadium for a 3:30 p.m. ET game on ESPN. The live card on this site lists Texas at No. 6, and that is the ranking this story will use. The Longhorns' own site has been billing the team as No. 8/8/5 this week (including a Butkus Award finalist note on linebacker Biles). ESPN's game header showed Texas at No. 5. When the school, the network and the card disagree, we stay with the card and tell you the rest.

Arkansas is 4-6 after a 34-6 win over South Carolina. Texas is 8-2. Arch Manning has 2,198 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and 10 interceptions; Raleek Brown leads the Longhorns' rush. KJ Jackson has 2,041 passing yards for the Razorbacks, and Chris Marshall has 761 receiving yards. Steve Sarkisian held a Nov. 19 media availability, posted as video by Texas, but the school did not publish a full Saturday designation list in the pages we could source.

This is not last week's one-score escape in Baton Rouge, and it is not a ranked-on-ranked date on the card. It is a November afternoon in Austin, a 4-6 visitor that just dropped 34 on South Carolina, and a Texas team whose official site cannot even agree with the card on its own ranking. If the Longhorns play like a group that just won in Tiger Stadium on the last snap, the afternoon should tilt orange. If Arkansas' passing game finds the same rhythm it had against South Carolina, DKR will have to earn the rest of the day.

articles.title: NC State at Florida State: A New Head Coach Named, Then a Trip to Tallahassee
articles.page_title: NC State at Florida State: A New Head Coach Named, Then a Trip to Tallahassee | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: NC State Wolfpack at Florida State Seminoles · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Doak Campbell Stadium · Tallahassee
articles.text:
NC State will walk into Doak Campbell Stadium a week after the school remade the letterhead. On Nov. 13, athletics director Boo Corrigan named former Wolfpack quarterback Philip Rivers the head coach, a five-year agreement, with a formal introduction on Nov. 16. On Nov. 16, Rivers and Corrigan named Jatavis Sanders general manager. On Nov. 18, Rivers named Jason Michael offensive coordinator. The official releases do not say who is calling Saturday's game in Tallahassee, and this story will not invent a sideline. What they do say is that the program has a new head coach, a new GM and a new coordinator, and that the team is still 4-6 after a 31-34 home loss to Syracuse in which the Wolfpack gave up a fourth-quarter lead.

Florida State is 5-5 after a 16-10 win at Pittsburgh, a second straight road win in the school's own recap headline. The Seminoles' Nov. 20 story on homecoming and Seminole Heritage Game activations redirected to a general gameday page, so this story will not invent a heritage script the useful text did not give us. The date is still 3:30 p.m. on ACC Network, in Tallahassee.

CJ Bailey has 2,289 passing yards, 14 touchdowns and five interceptions for the Wolfpack. Jayden Scott has 504 rushing yards. Ashton Daniels has 2,309 passing yards, 14 scores and 12 interceptions for Florida State; Ousmane Kromah leads the Seminoles' rush in the facts we can source. The AccuWeather note on ESPN's game page had a 20 percent rain chance and a 14-mph gust, not a storm, just a November afternoon in Tallahassee.

A 5-5 home team coming off a tight road win, and a 4-6 visitor whose week was about press conferences: that is the ACC Network window. Rivers, in his introductory remarks, said, "In many ways, I feel like I'm coming home." Saturday is still a road game in a stadium that does not care about last week's announcements.

articles.title: UCLA at Michigan: An Unbeaten Visitor Walks Into Senior Day at the Big House
articles.page_title: UCLA at Michigan: An Unbeaten Visitor Walks Into Senior Day at the Big House | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: UCLA Bruins at Michigan Wolverines · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Michigan Stadium · Ann Arbor
articles.text:
Michigan Stadium gets Senior Day, and the visitor is still unbeaten. Michigan's Monday notes said the Wolverines will recognize their seniors before kickoff against No. 4 UCLA, with the Wolverine Walk about 2 hours and 15 minutes before a 3:30 p.m. ET game on CBS. UCLA's official preview said the Bruins are 10-0 for the third time in program history after a 22-14 win over Illinois, and that they are one of two remaining unbeaten FBS teams, along with Utah. The No. 4 ranking, UCLA said, is their highest since Week 8 of 2001.

Michigan is 5-5 after a 7-31 loss at Oregon. The school's notes say this is the first meeting between the programs as Big Ten opponents. Michigan leads the all-time series 8-3, and the last meeting was a 23-20 UCLA win at the Rose Bowl. Michigan also said its defense ranks ninth nationally, allowing 276.5 yards per game, with linebacker Troy Bowles leading the team with 79 tackles.

UCLA's preview noted that quarterback Ty Dieffenbach left the Illinois game late in the first half with an injury and later returned. That is last Friday's report, not a Saturday designation for Ann Arbor, and this story will not turn it into one. Dieffenbach has 1,218 passing yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions in the facts we can source. Wayne Knight has 845 rushing yards and 13 scores. Bryce Underwood has 950 passing yards for Michigan.

An unbeaten November visitor, a Senior Day walk 2 hours and 15 minutes before kickoff, and a 5-5 home team coming off a 31-7 loss in Oregon: that is the CBS date in Ann Arbor. The farewell class gets its moment on the field. Then a 10-0 team that has not lost since the season started will try to keep it that way in the Big House.

Penn State's Rocco Becht has 2,163 passing yards, 18 touchdowns and five interceptions; Carson Hansen has 115-plus carries in the facts pack.

articles.matchup: Indiana Hoosiers at Washington Huskies · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Husky Stadium · Seattle
articles.text:
Washington closes its home schedule Saturday at Husky Stadium, a 12:30 p.m. PT kickoff on Peacock against No. 9 Indiana. The Huskies' official preview called it the home finale, with the regular-season closer still to come after this one. Indiana just beat No. 18 USC 27-13 in Bloomington, a game the Hoosiers' gameday notes said ended with Jamari Sharpe intercepting Jayden Maiava and returning it 34 yards. The live card on this site lists Indiana at No. 9. ESPN's game header showed No. 8. This story stays with the card and flags the network number.

The Hoosiers are 9-1. Josh Hoover has 1,860 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and two interceptions. Charlie Becker has 950 receiving yards and 10 scores, and Indiana's notes tied his 42-yard touchdown catch against USC as his 10th of the year. Washington is 6-4 after a 21-14 win at Michigan State on Nov. 14, a touchdown with 2:24 left in the school's recap. Demond Williams Jr. has 1,955 passing yards, 13 touchdowns and four interceptions. The Huskies' preview also said the program is already bowl eligible.

There is a human thread in Seattle this week that is not about the visitor. On Nov. 18 the school published a feature on punter Hunter Green and the No. 93 he wears for his father. It is a program story, not a scouting report, and it is part of what the home closer is supposed to feel like. Indiana is the 9-1 problem walking in the door.

A home finale in Seattle, a 9-1 visitor coming off a win over USC, and a 6-4 Husky team that already has its bowl math: that is the Peacock window. If Indiana's passing game looks like 19 touchdowns and two interceptions, the home finale will be a test. If Washington finishes the way it did at Michigan State, with 2:24 left on the clock, the students will still be standing at the whistle.

articles.title: Old Dominion at UConn: Senior Day at The Rent, and a First Look at the Monarchs
articles.page_title: Old Dominion at UConn: Senior Day at The Rent, and a First Look at the Monarchs | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Old Dominion Monarchs at UConn Huskies · 3:30 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Pratt & Whitney Stadium · East Hartford
articles.text:
UConn will close its home schedule Saturday at Pratt & Whitney Stadium, a Senior Day against Old Dominion, with kickoff slated for 3:32 p.m. on CBS Sports Network. The Huskies' official preview called this the first meeting between the programs. A win, the school said, would make UConn bowl-eligible for a third straight season, and for the fourth time in five years, which would be the second-longest bowl-eligible streak in the program's FBS history after four straight appearances from 2007 through 2010.

The Huskies are 5-5 after a 46-22 win over James Madison. Kalieb Osborne had 362 yards of offense in that game, 16-of-20 for 274 yards and three scores through the air, plus 88 yards on the ground. Cyncir Bowers ran for 123 yards and two scores and caught another. Shamar Porter had four catches for 135 yards and a score, all career highs, per the school. Linebacker Hayden Pegg had 11 tackles, a sack and an interception and leads the team with 79 tackles.

Old Dominion is 3-7, coming off a 21-8 win at Coastal Carolina on Nov. 7 in the last completed game in the facts we can source. The Monarchs' own preview agreed this is the first meeting, and it noted a familiar face: UConn senior offensive lineman Mason Howard began his career at Old Dominion, redshirting in 2022. Quinn Henicle has 701 passing yards in the facts pack; Devin Roche has 441 rushing yards.

A Senior Day, a first meeting, and a home team one win from a third straight bowl: that is the afternoon in East Hartford. Osborne just completed 16 of 20. Old Dominion just won on the road at Coastal. The names will be read. Then the Huskies have to finish the bowl math themselves.

articles.title: Texas A&M at Oklahoma: One Win From a Bowl, and a Rivalry They Want to Rekindle
articles.page_title: Texas A&M at Oklahoma: One Win From a Bowl, and a Rivalry They Want to Rekindle | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Texas A&M Aggies at Oklahoma Sooners · 3:45 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Memorial Stadium (Norman, OK) · Norman
articles.text:
Mike Elko did not sound like a man who had run out of ideas, even after a 7-22 home loss to Tennessee. "We're going to continue every week to do whatever we think is possible to tweak, twist, change and to come up with what we believe is the best opportunity to go out Saturday and have success," the Texas A&M coach said in the school's Oklahoma-week press conference. "You don't ever stop trying to look for solutions." He also said a win Saturday would put the Aggies within a game of bowl eligibility, and that he still sees value in getting there. "I don't see that as a reason to not want to be bowl eligible."

Saturday is 2:45 p.m. CT at Gaylord Family-Oklahoma Memorial Stadium, on ESPN2, the first meeting of these programs as SEC opponents. Texas A&M's how-to-follow note called it the 32nd meeting all-time and the first since Jan. 4, 2013, when the Aggies beat the Sooners 41-13 in the Cotton Bowl. Elko called it a chance "to kind of rekindle a rivalry with Oklahoma, a team that we haven't played in a long time."

Oklahoma is 6-4 after a 24-17 win over Ole Miss. The Sooners' official game primer said Texas A&M is OU's first opponent since the UTEP opener that was not ranked or receiving votes in at least one of the two major polls, ending a streak of eight such games. The live card on this site also lists Oklahoma as unranked. ESPN's game header showed the Sooners at No. 22. This story stays with the card and flags the network number. Texas A&M is 4-6.

Elko on Oklahoma's defense: "They're very aggressive and how they attack, they're very pressure oriented, they've got really talented players and they give you a lot of multiple looks." The Aggies have to find an answer for that, and for a Sooners team that just beat a ranked Ole Miss club at home.

articles.title: Northern Illinois at North Dakota State: Harvest Bowl in the Dome, With an 0-10 Visitor
articles.page_title: Northern Illinois at North Dakota State: Harvest Bowl in the Dome, With an 0-10 Visitor | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Northern Illinois Huskies at North Dakota State Bison · 4:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Fargodome · Fargo
articles.text:
Fargo calls this one the Harvest Bowl, and North Dakota State has been calling it that since 1974. The Bison's official preview set kickoff for 3:10 p.m. at the Fargodome, on The CW, against Northern Illinois, with 22 seniors to be introduced before the game. NDSU listed itself 46-2-2 in the Harvest Bowl and said it has won 15 straight of them, including 48-16 over Northern Iowa last season.

The Bison are 8-2 after a 21-13 win at Hawai'i. The official preview also said NDSU is tied with Alabama, Missouri State and Texas Tech for the FBS lead with five defensive touchdowns this season. That is the school's number, and it is the kind of number a home crowd in the dome will want to see again. Northern Illinois is 0-10 after a 7-28 loss to Nevada. The Huskies have not won a game, and they have to open this one on the road, in a building that has been a Harvest Bowl problem for visitors for a long time.

NDSU's last game was a fourth-quarter rally in Honolulu. NIU's last game was a 21-point loss at home to Nevada. The facts we can source do not invent a hidden 0-10 plot twist. They do give you a 8-2 home team, a senior class of 22, and a visitor looking for its first win of the year.

A Harvest Bowl that dates to 1974, a 15-game streak in this setting, and an 0-10 visitor: that is Saturday in the Fargodome. Twenty-two names will be called. Then Northern Illinois has to see whether this dome feels any different than the first 10 Saturdays.

articles.text:

The official preview called it the final home game of the season, and it also called it a game for the Trojans' postseason life: Troy is 4-6 and 2-4 in the Sun Belt, and the school said a win keeps the bowl hunt alive. Georgia Southern is 6-4 and 5-1, and Troy's preview said an Eagles win would move them closer to a first Sun Belt East title.

Goose Crowder is the home quarterback, and Saturday is the final home start of his career, per the school. Last week at South Alabama he threw and ran for scores, both on fourth down, in a 14-27 loss. He has 1,393 passing yards, 10 touchdowns and five interceptions; he also ran 11 times for 58 yards and a score in that loss. Georgia Southern comes in on a different kind of heater. Max Johnson has 2,398 passing yards, 17 touchdowns and only three interceptions, and last week he went 16-of-22 for 203 yards and two scores in a 34-17 win at Georgia State. articles.title: Georgia State at Marshall: Two 5-5 Teams, and a Bowl Bid Sitting on the Result
articles.page_title: Georgia State at Marshall: Two 5-5 Teams, and a Bowl Bid Sitting on the Result | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Georgia State Panthers at Marshall Thundering Herd · 4:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Joan C. Edwards Stadium · Huntington
articles.text:
Marshall's official preview put the whole season on one sentence: the winner of Saturday's game at Joan C. Edwards Stadium becomes bowl eligible. The Herd is 5-5 and 2-4 in the Sun Belt after a 16-20 loss to App State. Georgia State is 5-5 after a 17-34 loss to Georgia Southern. Kickoff is 4:02 p.m., per the school's Know Before You Go, on ESPN+. Before the game, Marshall will honor 23 seniors in their final home appearance, including running back Jo'Shon Barbie, who ran 17 times for 108 yards last week. Offensive lineman Jalen Slappy is making his 40th career start, the school said.

The gameday note asked the crowd to wear white and billed a Fan Appreciation Celebration and a Salute to Service, with free popcorn for everyone in the building. That is the official welcome in Huntington, and it is a much warmer welcome than Georgia State got last week in Atlanta, where the Panthers lost 17-34 to Georgia Southern. The football problem is simpler. Carlos Del Rio-Wilson has 1,213 passing yards, six touchdowns and five interceptions for Marshall. Cameran Brown has 1,356 passing yards, 14 scores and five interceptions for Georgia State, and Lanear McCrary Jr. has 612 rushing yards.

Two 5-5 teams, 23 seniors walking out, and a bowl bid sitting on the result: that is 4 o'clock in Huntington. If Marshall plays like a group that just had a 108-yard afternoon from a senior back, the white shirts will have something to take home. If Georgia State's passing game looks like 14 touchdowns, the Fan Appreciation crowd will have to become a fourth-quarter crowd in a hurry.

articles.title: South Alabama at Southern Miss: Senior Day in Hattiesburg, a Bowl Chance on the Road
articles.page_title: South Alabama at Southern Miss: Senior Day in Hattiesburg, a Bowl Chance on the Road | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: South Alabama Jaguars at Southern Miss Golden Eagles · 4:00 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · M. M. Roberts Stadium · Hattiesburg
articles.text:
Southern Miss will honor its 2026 seniors before its last date at M.M. Roberts Stadium, a Saturday kickoff against South Alabama on ESPN+. The official preview listed a senior class that includes receiver Mario Sanders, linebacker Avery Sledge, long snapper Andrew Tate, and offensive linemen Kendrick Watkins and Christian Young, among others. After this one, the Golden Eagles still have a trip to Norfolk left on the schedule.

The football argument is more urgent for the visitor. South Alabama is 5-5 after a 27-14 win over Troy, a result that put the Jaguars on the doorstep of a bowl. Jared Hollins has 1,195 passing yards, nine touchdowns and four interceptions; PJ Martin has 639 rushing yards and seven scores. Southern Miss is 3-7 after a 31-63 loss at Louisiana Tech. The school's Senior Day preview said redshirt junior Steven Robinson, a Conerly Trophy finalist, leads the Golden Eagles and the Sun Belt with 876 rushing yards and 10 rushing scores, plus an 11th touchdown as a receiver. Quarterback John White, the same preview said, is expected to make his third start in a row after 43-of-80 passing for 486 yards.

A Senior Day in Hattiesburg, a 5-5 visitor one win from a bowl, and a home back who already leads the league in rushing: that is Saturday in Hattiesburg. If Robinson runs like a Sun Belt leader, the farewell class will leave happy. If South Alabama plays the way it did in last week's 27-14 win over Troy, the Jaguars will take their bowl math back down I-10 and leave the goodbye for another week.

articles.title: Maryland at USC: A Year Later, Maryland Comes Back to the Coliseum
articles.page_title: Maryland at USC: A Year Later, Maryland Comes Back to the Coliseum | The Cover Window
articles.matchup: Maryland Terrapins at USC Trojans · 6:15 PM ET Sat Nov 21 · Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum · Los Angeles
articles.text:
Maryland has already beaten USC once in this series, 29-28, on Oct. 19, 2024, and Saturday the Terrapins go back to the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum to face No. 18 USC for, Maryland's official preview said, the first time in program history on the road in this matchup. Kickoff is 6:15 p.m. ET on Big Ten Network. The live card on this site and ESPN's game header both list USC at No. 18. The Trojans are 7-3 after a 13-27 loss at Indiana, a game in which Jayden Maiava threw for 311 yards, one score and three interceptions. Maryland is 4-6 after a 24-21 win over Wisconsin.

That Wisconsin win is the new starting point. Maryland's preview said Cardell Williams, in his first start as a Terp, went 21-of-23 for 183 yards and accounted for all three touchdowns (one passing, two rushing). Sean O'Haire kicked a 30-yard field goal with 29 seconds left, his first career game-winner, and was named Big Ten special teams player of the week. Preston Howard caught a 39-yard score that tied the game. USC still has Maiava, and Trent Mosley had nine catches for 130 yards in Bloomington, but the Trojans also had those three interceptions, including the late interception by Jamari Sharpe that closed Indiana's win.

A 4-6 visitor that just won on a kick with 29 seconds left, a No. 18 home team coming off a three-interception afternoon, and a series that already has one Maryland win in it: that is Saturday night at the Coliseum. If Williams is as sharp as 21-of-23, the Trojans will have to answer late again. If USC cleans up the football, the home night will look more like a ranked team at home and less like last week in Bloomington.
